meta.title: Application Facade Module
meta.summary: Native Host 与共享 Web Runtime Platform 的唯一 Core 入口

cards.title: Dependencies
cards.body: Full Facade links Performance Runtime and Runtime-only Facade, two independent narrow targets in the same Module. Runtime-only links Cooker/Audio, never Project IO or Provider SDK. Host owner selector → Facade → SDK policy/binding/budget gates → Project IO verified Asset read under one writer lease → owned source/sink. Session grants reset on restart; durable Attempts never contain Project paths or alter Truth. Persist intent before execute. One live Attempt per Job; short owner lease publishes stable Set, ordered history, active pointer and supersession atomically. Recover only recorded Attempts; verify terminal bytes on each read. Project Truth remains unchanged.

cards.title: Candidate adoption / runtime export
cards.body: One active set, explicit sorted Pad targets. Hold Workspace eligibility through bounded interval materialization, final-binding Bank/generation quota and one Project commit. Recheck Project/source identity under the writer. Retain source and terminal lineage; no Index adopted write and no public receipt replay. Cancel exact pending Attempt; discard active Set with durable tombstone. Share mutation ownership with adoption; late cancelled success never publishes. Keep immutable history/blobs, no GC or TTL. Runtime export: Expected Project ID/revision + one Pattern + extra live Pads. Load verified Truth, narrow a detached value, Cook and encode; return opaque bytes plus complete identity. No Project write or runtime publication. Candidate audition holds active eligibility through verified bounded PCM selection and final source/revision checks; transient prepared PCM only, no files or Truth writes. CLI/MCP return metadata; Native/Web own actual voice admission and stop.

cards.title: Performance authority
cards.body: Twenty Performance operations plus three Pattern Slot commands; open gestures, HOLD and the last acknowledged launch come from record status, never from Host prediction.

cards.title: Runtime boundary
cards.body: Budget Engine plus 2176-state receipt-bounded storage. Acquire consumption, drain states, retire receipts. OPEN/BUSY drain before reclaim. Control-only Pad summary is an owned, allocation-free canonical 64-slot value; Host profile does not narrow Core capacity. Cardputer serial control owns load and receipts; its audio task alone renders. Device join and physical silence remain separate from Core stopped. No physical-device proof.
